advancements.caverns_and_chasms.husbandr: Apply Beeswax to a Copper block or golem!
Use an Infernite or Necromium Ingot to upgrade a hoe, and then reevaluate your life choices
Use Infernite and Necromium Ingots to upgrade two hoes, and then realize that life is insignificant
lore.caverns_and_chasms.ancient_scrap: A scorched metal fragment smelted from Ancient Debris. Combine it with Gold to make an Infernite Ingot.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.iron_chain: A block that can be used to hang Lanterns or Hanging Signs from the ceiling. Blocks chained to something moved by a piston come along with it.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.amethyst: This block can repeat vibrations, and makes a Note Block above it chime. It can redirect Beacon beams, and can't be crafted back into Amethyst Shards.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.cavefish: A cave fish caught in underground water between Y -64 and Y 40.
entity.caverns_and_chasms.cavefish.descr: A pale, blind fish found in underground water. Fits in a bucket.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.cavefish_bucket: A bucket holding a live Cavefish. Empty it into water to release it.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.sugilite: A purple stone found in deep caves. It clatters with a discordant sound when struck.
block.caverns_and_chasms.sugilite.descri: A purple stone found in deep caves. It clatters with a discordant sound when struck.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.refractor: A Flux diode that splits an incoming signal out to its left, front, and right. Click each output on its top to adjust or switch it off.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.resistor: A Flux diode that weakens a signal passing through it by a set amount, from 1 to 14. Click it to raise the resistance, or sneak-click to lower it. Powering its side also steps it up.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.bouncer: A springy target block. Entities bounce high off it and take less fall damage, and projectiles that hit it give off a Flux signal and can ricochet.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tin_bulb: A lamp that steps up to the next brightness each time it's powered, cycling back to off after the brightest. A Comparator can read its level.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.dimmer: A dial that slowly turns up its Flux signal while you hold use on it. A Comparator can read its level.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.hoop: A ring that gives off a short Flux pulse when a projectile is shot through it. Its size can be adjusted.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.winch: A crank that winds up a Flux signal while you hold use on it, and gives power to the block it's attached to.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.scatterer: A Dispenser that fires every slot at once, scattering Fire Charges and Firework Rockets in a spread.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.splurter: A Dropper that drops from all of its slots in a random order at once.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.copper_rail: A rail made from Copper. It oxidizes over time unless waxed.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.exposed_copper_r: A rail made from Copper that has started to oxidize.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.weathered_copper: A rail made from Copper that is weathering away.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.oxidized_copper_: A rail made from Copper that has fully oxidized.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.waxed_copper_rai: A rail made from Copper, waxed to stop it oxidizing.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.waxed_exposed_co: A rail made from Copper, waxed to stop it oxidizing.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.waxed_weathered_: A rail made from Copper, waxed to stop it oxidizing.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.waxed_oxidized_c: A rail made from Copper, waxed to stop it oxidizing.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.halt_rail: A rail that raises a barrier to stop Minecarts in their tracks when powered from its ends.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.slaughter_rail: A Silver rail lined with spikes. While powered, it deals magic damage to creatures that pass over it.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tmt_minecart: A Minecart carrying TMT. It blasts nearby entities away when triggered by an Activator Rail, without harming blocks.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tmt: A non-damaging explosive made from Dynamite and Amethyst. It knocks back everything around it greatly, but leaves blocks intact.
block.caverns_and_chasms.tmt.description: A non-damaging explosive made from Dynamite and Amethyst. It knocks back everything around it greatly, but leaves blocks intact.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.blunt_arrow: An arrow tipped with Amethyst. It knocks targets back without dealing damage.
item.caverns_and_chasms.blunt_arrow.desc: An arrow tipped with Amethyst. It knocks targets back without dealing damage.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.ricochet_arrow: A Tin-tipped arrow that bounces off blocks instead of sticking in them.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.sparkler: A firework placed like a torch. Light it and it sparkles until it burns out. Dye it to change the colour of its sparks.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.gunpowder_block: A compact block of nine Gunpowder.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.diamond_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Diamond and Glowstone.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.quartz_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Quartz and Glowstone.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.amethyst_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Amethyst and Glowstone.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.roller_window: A Roller Door with a window in it. It rolls up when powered or used.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.roller_door: A metal shutter that rolls up and down when powered or used.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.azalea_beehive: A Beehive made of Azalea wood. Bees can live in it and fill it with Honey.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.packing_containe: A Tin container that holds a single kind of item, up to 512 of it. Right-click items into it in your inventory, like a Bundle.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.monocle: A Copper monocle that can be worn on the head.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.toolbelt: A belt worn on the legs that lets you reach blocks 2 blocks further away.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.cowl: A hood that makes you stealthier, so monsters notice you from less far away.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.unicorn_horn: A horn that can be fitted onto a Horse. Shear it to take it back off.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.bone_flute: A flute left behind when a pack of Rats is tamed with a Rotten Flesh block. Play it to command your Rats: aim at a creature to attack it, look down to make them sit, or play it anywhere to call them back.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.trim_modifier_sm: A template used in a Smithing Table to give trimmed armor an extra effect, using Amethyst, Glow Ink, or Prismarine.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.evendeeper_head: The head of a Weeper. It can be worn or placed as a decoration.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.kunai: Small Silver throwing knives that deal some magic damage along with their stab.
item.caverns_and_chasms.kunai.descriptio: Small Silver throwing knives that deal some magic damage along with their stab.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.zirconia: A rare scrap of mixed materials found in loot chests.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tin_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Tin.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.deepslate_tin_or: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Tin.

lore.caverns_and_chasms.soul_silver_ore: A Nether ore found in Soul Sand Valleys that drops Silver Nuggets.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tin_ingot: A soft metal often used in Flux components.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.raw_tin: A chunk of raw ore that can be smelted into a Tin Ingot.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.tin_nugget: A small piece of Tin that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.netherite_nugget: A small piece of Infernite that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.caverns_and_chasms.necromium_ingot: A darkly gleaming alloy of Ancient Scrap and Silver. Used in equipment that slows and weakens its targets.
